# QIT M365 Managed: technician runbook

*Generated by generate_reports.py from report_levels.json and CIPP's standards.json. Don't edit this file by hand.*

**Microsoft license:** Microsoft Entra ID P1

Managed replaces security defaults with conditional access: MFA for every user, legacy authentication blocked, phishing-resistant sign-in for administrators, and MFA for guests. It adds a banned password list and trusted MFA claims from named partner tenants. Checks the Baseline report already covers are not repeated here.

Reaching Managed needs Microsoft Entra ID P1, which Microsoft 365 Business Premium includes, and a project to deploy conditional access, starting in report-only mode.

**Checks:** 21. **Dashboard suite:** QIT M365 Managed.

## How to use this runbook

Results appear on the CIPP Dashboard: select the tenant, then the suite named above. Refresh Test Data re-runs every CIPP test for the tenant. A full refresh can take from a few minutes to a couple of hours.

Each check shows one of these statuses:

- **Passed**: the tenant meets the check.
- **Failed**: it doesn't. Fix it with the standard under Fix with CIPP, or by hand, using the steps CIPP shows for the test.
- **Investigate**: CIPP found something a person should review. Read the result in CIPP.
- **Informational**: reported for context, with no pass or fail.
- **Skipped**: the test didn't run, often because the tenant lacks the license or feature it needs. Read the result in CIPP.

Each entry shows the risk, the effort to fix and the impact on users, as CIPP rates them.

**Fix with CIPP** lists the CIPP standards linked to the check. CIPP's links are sometimes wrong. Where QIT has checked a link and found it wrong, the entry names the right fix and says why. After changing anything, confirm the result on the next test refresh.

Build the QIT M365 Managed standards template in your own CIPP from the standards and conditional access policies named in this runbook. It can't ship in this repo, because ConditionalAccessTemplate references a template GUID unique to each CIPP instance. Start conditional access policies in report-only mode, and read the sign-in logs before enforcing them.

### EIDSCAPR01 — Password Rule Settings - Password Protection Mode

Risk: High · Effort: Medium · User impact: Low

**Fix with CIPP:** no standard at this level fixes it.

**Elsewhere in CIPP:** `SmartLockout` (Configure Entra ID Smart Lockout, Medium Impact, not in a QIT level).

**QIT note:** CIPP's link corrected: The check needs on-premises password protection in Enforce mode. CustomBannedPasswordList leaves that mode at Audit; SmartLockout can set it.

**Links:** [Microsoft Learn: howto password ban bad on premises deploy](https://learn.microsoft.com/entra/identity/authentication/howto-password-ban-bad-on-premises-deploy) · [Microsoft Learn: concept password ban bad](https://learn.microsoft.com/entra/identity/authentication/concept-password-ban-bad) · [Microsoft Learn: tutorial configure custom password protection](https://learn.microsoft.com/entra/identity/authentication/tutorial-configure-custom-password-protection)

### EIDSCAPR05 — Password Rule Settings - Lockout duration in seconds

Risk: Medium · Effort: Low · User impact: Low

**Fix with CIPP:** `CustomBannedPasswordList` (Set Entra ID Custom Banned Password List, Medium Impact). Configure in your QIT M365 Managed template.

**Elsewhere in CIPP:** `SmartLockout` (Configure Entra ID Smart Lockout, Medium Impact, not in a QIT level).

**QIT note:** CIPP's link corrected: CustomBannedPasswordList writes a 60-second lockout only when it first creates the password settings, and keeps existing values after that. SmartLockout sets the duration explicitly.

**Links:** [Microsoft Learn: howto password smart lockout](https://learn.microsoft.com/entra/identity/authentication/howto-password-smart-lockout) · [Microsoft Learn: concept password policies](https://learn.microsoft.com/entra/identity/authentication/concept-password-policies) · [Microsoft Learn: howto password smart lockout (configure smart lockout)](https://learn.microsoft.com/entra/identity/authentication/howto-password-smart-lockout#configure-smart-lockout)

**Full description and manual steps:** in CIPP, Dashboard > QIT M365 Managed > EIDSCAPR05. Without the QIT suites, use CIPP's built-in EIDSCA suite.
